Name: Em's Statues
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A sword in a stone, or a well-crafted shield, as the statue of True/Perfection and Endless Fortune. Replaces the bears.
Each statue can be disabled and has three/four options. Choose the one that speaks to you!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/xCL13M1D/Sword.png[/img]

Have you had your battles? Fought for your rewards?
The shine in these swords is worth your efforts

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/k4WgvKgP/Shield.png[/img]

Lay down your shield, and let it bring you the rest you deserve
﻿The stones embedded in the wood show you the rewards of your work[b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]﻿
[/b]
Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url][b] [/b]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]
[/b][/url]Download and unzip "Em's Statues of Perfection CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

If you want to change the statues' look:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Em's mod folder
Replace the "[color=#e69138]Type[/color]" with the version you like
There is a reference image in the mod folder
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ySh95dL/AT.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
Download and unzip "Em's Statues of Perfection AT"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Buy the paint tools from Robin at the Carpenter's shop
With the paint bucket selected, right-click on the statue to make your choice
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1 Added a shadow underneath the statue. A config option is available for the CP file. An AT file is available.
Update 1.2 Added new versions of the statue and three options for the Statue of True Perfection
Update 1.2 Added four options for the Statue of Endless Fortune. Each statue can be disabled[/i]
